scripts.dev: npm run build -w @email-qa/core && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @email-qa/api" "npm run dev -w @email-qa/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @email-qa/core && npm run build -w @email-qa/web && npm run build -w @email-qa/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w @email-qa/core && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @email-qa/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces
